rows.quote: This investigation harnessed the unparalleled breadth of plasma protein and KSD pooled genome-wide association study (GWAS) data, sourced from the United Kingdom Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKBPPP) and the FinnGen database version R10.
rows.coder_note: Sentence gives the KSD GWAS data as sourced from the FinnGen database version R10, the release number of the FinnGen R10 row (rule A); the same release is repeated in sentence 5 and nothing conflicts.

rows.name_as_written: United Kingdom Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKBPPP)
rows.coder_note: Abstract names the UKBPPP only, with no sample size, subcohort, ancestry or citation; the name alone does not separate the UKB-PPP rows (rule D).
